name: Ougi Konoha
source:
She is always looking at other people's faces and always frightened, as if she lacks self-confidence.
Her personality is also somewhat dull and sloppy, and she is the lowest rank among apprentice knights.

However, she always tries her best to be a knight. She is cheered on by her friends with a smile.

[Translated description from [url=http://www.ensemble-game.com/25.secretagent/character.html]Ensemble[/url]]

[spoiler] An Orphan, later adopted by a ninja group. She considers the ninja group a 'family'. She uses her ninja training to be 'bat', as to gather fame to know her 'family' whereabouts.[/spoiler]
